headword: {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}
reading: しょうばいはんじょう

definitions.gloss: prosperous business; thriving trade; flourishing commerce
definitions.explanation: A business doing well, with plenty of customers and sales. A set phrase strongly associated with good-luck charms and prayers for commercial success.

examples.japanese: {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}を{祈|いの}る。
この{神社|じんじゃ}は{商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}のご{利益|りやく}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This shrine is famous for its blessing of business prosperity.

examples.japanese: {店先|みせさき}に{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}を{飾|かざ}って、{商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}を{願|ねが}った。
examples.english: They placed a beckoning cat at the storefront, wishing for a thriving business.

notes:
A fixed four-character phrase used mainly in the context of prayers, charms, and good wishes for a store or company. Often seen on {縁起物|えんぎもの} (lucky charms) and shrine {お札|ふだ} (talismans).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}を{祈|いの}る: to pray for business success
- {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}のお{守|まも}り: a charm for prosperous business
- {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}の{神様|かみさま}: a deity of commercial success
